## Profile

Data Scientist trained at the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, focused on applied
machine learning and artificial intelligence, with published end-to-end projects:
predictive models on educational data, an open housing dataset with a DOI, and
human activity recognition from sensor data. Ten years translating complex
information into decisions for non-technical teams across clinical, sports and
teaching settings led me to specialise in data as the basis for decision-making.
Interested in machine learning and deep learning applied to problems with
measurable consequences.

## Technical skills

**Languages** — Python, SQL, R

**Tools** — Git, CI/CD, Docker

**Libraries** — Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn

**Machine learning** — linear and logistic regression, classification (XGBoost,
Random Forest, SVM, KNN), clustering (K-means, DBSCAN), time series

**Deep learning** — TensorFlow, PyTorch, CNN, RNN, Hugging Face Transformers,
BERT, embeddings, NER

## Projects

### Human Activity Recognition from IMU Sensors {.cv-entry}

::: {.cv-meta}
Python, PyTorch, Scikit-learn · MSc thesis, UOC · 2026
:::

- Activity classification from accelerometer and gyroscope time series:
  preprocessing, signal windowing and feature extraction.
- Benchmarking of classical models against neural network architectures.

### Alicante Housing Market Analysis {.cv-entry}

::: {.cv-meta}
Python, Pandas, SQL, Selenium, Scikit-learn · 2026 ·
[Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.17583274)
:::

- End-to-end data pipeline on 1,802 property listings: collection, cleaning,
  geocoding and geospatial enrichment.
- Market segmentation into price clusters and identification of the key drivers
  of property value.
- Released as an open dataset with a DOI.

### ED-Alert {.cv-entry}

::: {.cv-meta}
Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Tableau · 2026 ·
[Tableau Public](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/jordi.sanjuan.jover/viz/PR2_Visualizacion-ED_Alert/Historia1)
:::

- Analysis of early school leaving across Spanish regions and against Europe
  (ELET indicator), combined with PISA 2022 data.
- Identification of the strongest predictors of dropout risk using Random
  Forest, and detection of natural student groupings with MCA.
- Interactive Tableau visualisation for vocational-training guidance counsellors.
